    Write the ignition and/or escape fit tables to outputPath(sim)

    saveFitTables.Rd

    Runs after the prep events, as its own uncached event, so it sees the tables whether prepIgnitionFitData just built them or its cache restored them. It only reads them: no table and no cache key changes. Each file is <object>_<ELF>.qs2 (sim$.ELFind; no ELF suffix without one) and is listed in outputs(sim). A requested table the run did not build (skipUnusedFitPrep) is reported, not an error.

    saveFitTables(sim)

    Arguments

    sim

    a simList.

    Value

    the simList, invisibly, with the files registered as outputs.
